title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (r) — review required
description: In r, naming MD5 (algos*=s*["']md5["']) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The r-specific remedy is selecting algo="sha256".
applicability: r codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
